title: Meta-analysis of proportions in the browser: a tool validated against the R packages metafor and meta
description: Version 1.1.0 validation archive for allmeta v1.8.0 (1cb3f8409c7af75ed41f7e1811f9c502f900fc79, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23515177). The release run on 2026-10-20 completed 26 labelled commands with RUN_EXIT 0: 298116/298116 original checks, 7248/7248 extras presentation/export checks, 2176/2176 native pair comparisons and 4352/4352 generated native-script comparisons. Live webR/native comparison passed 2139/2166 assertions with 27 failures retained; the exact documented-exceptions contract passed. Original corpus, references and tolerances remain unchanged. Evidence: provenance/run_plan-2026-10-20-release.log and release-run.json. Exact Git blob restoration and manifest verification use FINAL_BLOBS.cmd before publication.
